usages, sign separate, edited pictures, 88 and REDEFINES
pointer and index tables report whole-table sizes
COPY REPLACING, qualified references
files, qualification, dynamic and literal calls, two programs
one occurrence versus whole table by usage
OCCURS with a constant bound, constant pictures, larger REDEFINES
hexadecimal and Z literal byte lengths, screen VALUE constants
directives after a sequence area, DEFINE OVERRIDE, evaluated IF/ELIF
REPLACE substituting inside picture strings
a REDEFINES larger than what it redefines
RENAMES spans, including qualified and group operands
screen entries sized from USING and FROM items
a copybook DEFINE deciding an IF branch in the copying file
a CALL naming a level-78 constant, a space-padded literal program name, and a genuinely dynamic CALL
COPY naming a copybook with its file extension — the period before .cpy is not the statement terminator
EXEC SQL INCLUDE brings in a copybook whole, its first entry included, in the data and the procedure division
COPY DOTWS.WS. names the member DOTWS.WS, and a COPY ended by a period does not swallow the paragraph header on the next line
GnuCOBOL's MODULE-* and CONCAT functions under FUNCTION ALL INTRINSIC, NUMBER-OF-CALL-PARAMETERS and ACCEPT FROM MICROSECOND-TIME resolve without a declaration
comment-entries after AUTHOR, DATE-WRITTEN and SECURITY run on through every line with Area A blank, a COPY and an apostrophe in them included
a tag written against other text, 'X'-CLE and FS-(), is replaced where it stands, and the text around it joins the replacement into one word

SYNCHRONIZED aligns binary, float, pointer and index items to their length, counted from the record's start, with the slack inside the group that holds them; a table entry is rounded up to its widest alignment
an FD needs no FILE SECTION header before it, whether it opens a copybook or follows one
report groups are laid out by column, a report file is as wide as its widest report, and the listing prints the last report's groups only
TYPE and TYPE TO give an item the size and subordinate items of its TYPEDEF, which qualification reaches and the listing does not print
WITH DEBUGGING MODE declares DEBUG-ITEM and its subordinate items, which a program uses without declaring
a program that opens at SPECIAL-NAMES, with no identification division, is one program named for its file
a paragraph or section header in Area A ends the sentence before it without a period, and an Area B word before a period stays an operand
in Micro Focus free form a * or / in column 1 makes the line a comment, and an indented * multiplies
MOVE CORRESPONDING writes each receiving item it pairs, skipping OCCURS, REDEFINES and FILLER, and a condition-name's qualifier is not a reference to it
SUBSTITUTE, SUBSTITUTE-CASE and the MODULE-* functions, B-SHIFT-L and B-SHIFT-R, COB-CRT-STATUS, UPON STDOUT and STDERR, and RETURNING NOTHING need no declaration
floating-point, NC and H literals, a quote doubled across a continuation, INCLUDE as COPY, and $SET CONSTANT with $IF, $ELSE and $END
a group reference reaches the items under it, but not through an unnamed FILLER group, a FILLER REDEFINES among them; a reference below one still reaches the group above
a COPY REPLACING reaches the copybooks nested in it, except the words their own REPLACING produced
a qualifier is a reference only where the name it qualifies is declared more than once, for a data name and a condition-name alike
a COPY REPLACING operand may be a qualified or subscripted identifier
an FD is as long as its RECORD clause allows, read past LABEL RECORD, or its longest record, one occurrence of an OCCURS record, and a line-sequential file by its records alone
REPLACE replaces a colon-delimited tag inside a picture and a name, and pseudo-text that ends a picture with a period
debugging lines are source under WITH DEBUGGING MODE, and DEBUG-CONTENTS is as long as the item USE FOR DEBUGGING names
a U picture symbol is a UTF-8 character of four bytes
a screen item shows its numeric VALUE as written and, where a missing period runs entries together, the later VALUE
a report group is as large as its items end to end or its rightmost column, and every group of a report as large as the largest
files sharing a record area each list the area's records in the listing, which are declared once
